description: Allow users to create and select custom storyboard templates

tasks.title: Add customTemplates to store
tasks.description: Persist custom templates in Zustand and expose add action.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/lib/store.ts includes customTemplates: Template[]
Store exports addCustomTemplate(template: Template)
Store partialize persists customTemplates
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Added customTemplates state, addCustomTemplate action, and persistence.

tasks.title: Update template lookup for custom templates
tasks.description: Ensure selectTemplate can resolve custom template ids.
acceptanceCriteria: File src/lib/templates.ts exports getTemplateById(id, customTemplates?)
selectTemplate checks customTemplates before built-in templates
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Updated getTemplateById and selectTemplate to resolve custom templates.

tasks.title: Add custom template form state
tasks.description: Track custom template name/description and beats in SetupTab.
acceptanceCriteria: SetupTab has state for template name and description
SetupTab has beats state with title and guidance
Handlers exist to add and remove beats
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Added custom template form state and beat handlers in SetupTab.

tasks.title: Render custom template creation UI
tasks.description: Add inputs and beat editor in SetupTab.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - app loads
agent-browser: snapshot -i - custom template form fields visible
tasks.notes: Rendered custom template form in SetupTab and verified inputs in browser.

tasks.title: Save custom template and auto-select
tasks.description: Create a Template from form data and select it on save.
acceptanceCriteria: Save handler builds template with unique id and beats
addCustomTemplate called with new template
selectTemplate called with new template id
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Save handler builds template, stores it, and auto-selects the new template.

tasks.title: Validate required fields
tasks.description: Require template name and at least one beat before save.
acceptanceCriteria: Save button disabled until name + one beat title exist
Inline error appears when attempting save without required fields
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Save button now enforces required fields with inline errors.

tasks.title: Show custom templates in selection list
tasks.description: Display custom templates alongside built-ins in SetupTab.
acceptanceCriteria: Custom templates render in the template list
Custom templates are labeled or grouped as Custom
Run `npm run build` - exits with code 0
tasks.notes: Custom templates now render in the template list with a Custom badge.

tasks.title: Browser test: create custom template
tasks.description: Verify user can create a custom template.
acceptanceCriteria: agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - page loads
agent-browser: fill template name input with "My Template"
agent-browser: fill first beat title input with "Beat 1"
agent-browser: fill first beat guidance input with "Guidance"
agent-browser: click Save Template - new template appears and is selected

tasks.title: Browser test: select custom template
tasks.description: Verify selecting custom template updates frames and persists.
acceptanceCriteria: agent-browser: open http://localhost:3000 - page loads
agent-browser: click custom template in list - selection updates
agent-browser: snapshot - frame titles match custom beats
agent-browser: reload - custom template still listed
